GIT_DEFAULT_BRANCH.description: The default branch name for your Git repository

GIT_REPO_LOCAL_PATH.description: Optional: Local Git repository path. If omitted, defaults to the current working directory

FREEE_REDIRECT_URI.description: OAuth redirect URI (must match the one configured in freee Developers)

FREEE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Your freee application client secret obtained from freee Developers

AWS_SESSION_TOKEN.description: AWS session token for temporary credentials (AWS SSO)
